# Ruminate X: AI film studio for brand films and AI commercials

> Ruminate X is an AI film studio in Calgary, Canada, founded in 2024 by Abhi Chawla. It makes brand films and AI commercials for consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses. Every frame it delivers is made with generative AI. There are no film crews, sets or location shoots.

## Identity

- **Company type:** AI film studio (AI video production)
- **Founded:** 2024
- **Founder:** Abhi Chawla
- **Location:** Calgary, Alberta, Canada
- **Tagline:** No idea is impossible.

## What Ruminate X makes

- **Brand films:** a story-driven film about what a brand stands for
- **AI commercials:** ads for TV, streaming, web and social
- **About-us and company films:** a film that introduces a company, its mission or its work
- **Avatar videos:** a presenter or spokesperson video made with AI
- **UGC-style ads:** ads in the style of creator videos
- **Review-style videos:** review and testimonial-style videos
- **Product visuals:** product films and stills

## How the work is made

Every frame Ruminate X delivers is made with generative AI. Clients brief the studio; the studio handles the concept, script, boards, generation, edit, sound and grade. The published process is at https://www.ruminatex.com/how-we-make-an-ai-brand-film.

Prices and turnaround are quoted per project. Ruminate X does not publish a price list.

## Who hires Ruminate X

Brand and marketing managers, founders, communications teams and agency producers at consumer brands, pharma and pharmacy companies, labs, medical companies and other businesses.

## Guides for buyers

- [How to Hire an AI Video Production Agency](https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-agencies): tool vs agency vs production company, what drives the price, what breaks in AI footage, who owns the film, seven questions to ask
- [How Much Does AI Video Production Cost?](https://www.ruminatex.com/blog/how-much-does-ai-video-production-cost): published prices at four levels (tools, freelancers, AI studios, traditional production) with sources, cost drivers, what to send for a quote
- [AI Video for Pharma and Healthcare Marketing](https://www.ruminatex.com/ai-video-production-healthcare): uses in pharma, pharmacy, labs and medical, what MLR reviewers ask about AI footage, the US (21 CFR 202.1) and Canadian (C.01.044, PAAB) rules that shape a drug ad, what breaks in AI medical imagery
- [AI Video Agency vs Traditional Production](https://www.ruminatex.com/comparison/ai-agency-vs-traditional-agency): the two compared line by line, and which to hire for which brief
- [AI Video Character Consistency for Brands](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/ai-video-character-consistency): why faces drift between AI shots, the character sheet, reference features in the main video models, consent and disclosure rules for synthetic people, and keeping one person across a film and its campaign photos
- [First and Last Frame AI Video for Commercials](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/first-frame-last-frame-ai-video): how image-to-video starts a shot from an approved still, what each video model supports, what makes a clean first frame, and what a still costs next to a second of video
- [Brand World Building for AI Film and Photos](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/brand-world-building): what goes in a campaign world bible, the order that keeps an AI film and its photos in one world, and where AI-made worlds drift
- [Brand Visual DNA: The Look Brief for AI Film](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/brand-visual-dna): the photo fields of a visual DNA, the fields a film adds (movement, shot length, frame rate, grade, sound), and how to pull the DNA from your own films
- [Product and Label Accuracy in AI Commercials](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/ai-commercial-product-accuracy): why video models redraw products, what drifts, the fixes in order, the truth-in-advertising rules that apply, and the product reference pack to send a studio
- [Commercial Production Budget Template for AI](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/commercial-production-budget-template): the lines of a traditional commercial budget, which ones an AI film drops or adds, and a worked example for a film plus campaign stills, with sources
- [AI Campaign Stack: Tools Behind Film and Stills](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/ai-campaign-stack): the layers of an AI campaign from stills and key frames to video, voice, music, edit, grade and review, with tools and published prices
- [Ad Campaign Deliverables: Film and Stills](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/ad-campaign-deliverables): the films, cutdowns and stills each channel needs, with the official specs, and a deliverables list template
- [Video vs Static Ads: Where AI Film Fits](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/video-vs-static-ads): what platforms and published studies say about video and static ads, and how to split a creative budget between an AI film and campaign stills
- [AI Video Quality Control Before It Airs](https://www.ruminatex.com/guides/ai-video-quality-control): a checklist for AI commercials (faces, hands, product, text, continuity, sound, loudness, labels and rights) and the same checks for campaign stills
